messages:
maya: Quick escalation 1: Meridian Health pilot - CISO pushed back on our retention + BYO-KMS answers and they're expecting the trial to use committed discount for Dedicated. They want an exec call tomorrow. Need coordinated response. @ajay @oliver

devon: Got it. How strict is the BYO-KMS ask? Can we propose a fallback?

maya: They want keys under their Azure subscription for compliance. If we can't guarantee during pilot, they might delay.

ajay: BYO-KMS is available for Private. For Dedicated in AWS/EU we'd need infra validation and cross-team signoff (~3 weeks). My propose: offer hosted-managed keys during pilot + expedited validation plan for BYO-KMS. Include deletion certificate and redacted audit sample.

oliver: Finance: we can provide a provisional billing credit to mirror their expected discount for up to 30 days while legal finishes the amendment. Needs Sales Ops + RevOps sign-off.

sarah: I can route the provisional credit approval. We'll need a PO and trial scope doc. Maya, can you attach scope and estimated ARR?

maya: Uploaded scope: https://redwood.internal/drive/meridian-trial-scope (10k req/day, retention 30d). Expected ARR signal ~150k/yr.

devon: SE mitigation: canary routing plan - route 10% traffic to Dedicated with hosted keys, fallback to Hosted if KMS not available. I'll draft playbook and failure modes. Need customer allowlist IPs.

ajay: Draft reply text for sec questionnaire: "Retention: Pilot defaults to 30 days; expedited deletion on request (48h) with deletion certificate. Audit logs: sample redacted copy attached. BYO-KMS: Supported for Private deployments; Dedicated variants require infra validation (~3w). We propose hosted-key fallback for the pilot with strict access controls and encryption-at-rest."

meera: If they ask for escalation on compliance, I can join exec bridge as backup security lead after 17:00 UTC.

cto_jane: I can join the exec bridge tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Agree with staged approach: pilot on hosted keys + BYO-KMS validation path.

oliver: I'll prepare provisional credit terms for the brief and a single-use invoice template.

sarah: Preparing PO template. Maya, send final customer contacts so I can pre-fill.

maya: Contacts: nate@meridian-health.com (CTO), ciso@meridian-health.com. Assignments: ajay -> questionnaire reply + logs by 15:30; devon -> canary playbook + IPs; sarah -> PO + credit packet; oliver -> credit terms; maya -> schedule exec bridge and confirm participants.

deploy-bot: Reminder: add "meridian-pilot" to allowlist when SE posts IPs.

maya: Thanks all. I'll update the customer after we have draft reply and finance terms.

(End of thread)
